scope: Eight released thrown-weapon registrations, selected creation/spawn paths and two explosion builder segments. Not an explosion simulation or live cancellation reproduction.
limits: Impact damage zero is not proof of harmlessness; two items have separate explosion definitions
The selected base player path calls consume before projectile construction/spawn; failure paths need transaction tests
Dispenser asProjectile uses a different context-building path; hand/dispenser damage parity is not assumed
Explosion values are builder inputs, not guarantees of damage, affected blocks or drops
